title: Hip Vibe Space | 4 Miles from Broadway
description:
This distinctive home boasts its own unique style. It offers a beautiful setting and an ideal spot for any group visiting the city.

Bedroom 1 - Twin over Full Bunk Bed
Bedroom 2 - King Bed with the hats
Bedroom 3 - 3 Sets of twin Beds

The space
Make the most of your time with friends or family in our spacious home. Located just minutes from downtown, it's the ideal spot to prepare for a night out on Broadway or to unwind together in our large open-plan social area and fully equipped kitchen. With ample sleeping options and a cozy couch for watching your favorite shows, our home offers everything you need. Plus, it’s conveniently close to restaurants, nightlife, shopping, parks, and more.

Guest access
Keyless entry to the property via keypad. The details for the the keypad code will be sent to you prior to your reservation.

Other things to note
While the neighborhood is mostly quiet and safe this is still an urban environment and you should always remain aware of your surroundings and use common sense. We recommend that you don't leave valuables in your car and don't leave the doors and windows unlocked when you leave the house.
